items.title: Association Between Exercise and Brain-Derived Neurotrophic Factor (BDNF) Levels in Diabetes Mellitus: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.

ai.headline: Exercise may raise BDNF levels in people with diabetes, but evidence is limited.
ai.summary: This systematic review and meta-analysis looked at four trials involving 131 people with diabetes. ai.why_it_matters: It suggests exercise might support brain health in people with diabetes, but more research is needed before firm conclusions can be drawn.
